definitions.gloss: absence without notice; unauthorized absence from work
definitions.explanation: Being absent from work without informing one's employer or obtaining permission beforehand. A serious workplace infraction in Japan.

examples.japanese: {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Unauthorized absence from work is not tolerated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was absent from work for three days without notice.

examples.japanese: {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Continued unauthorized absences can become grounds for dismissal.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound of ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧ (without permission) + ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧ (absence from work). Used as a suru verb ({無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). This is considered a serious infraction in Japanese workplaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be absent without notice)
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (unauthorized absences continue)
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to repeatedly be absent without notice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧: absence from work — the general term, not necessarily unauthorized
- ⟦{無断|むだん}{欠席|けっせき}→無断欠席：21256_mudankesseki⟧: unauthorized absence — used for school or meetings rather than work
